findings.source_quote: A Christ-centered Courtship is a series of messages on godly courtship preached by Paul Hershberger.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the incorrect French "Une cour centrée sur Christ" with the idiomatic, accurate translation used in the translation metadata/title for consistency, e.g. "Une fréquentation centrée sur Christ". Ensure the same phrasing is used in the article-note and the article metadata/title to avoid inconsistent renderings.
findings.translation_quote: Une cour centrée sur Christ est une série de messages sur la fréquentation pieuse prêchés par Paul Hershberger.

findings.location: Throughout article: parenthetical Scripture references and blockquote attributions
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English book names in all parenthetical Scripture citations into conventional French forms while leaving chapter:verse numbers unchanged. Examples to use: Genesis -> Genèse; Luke -> Luc; 2 Timothy -> 2 Timothée; 1 Timothy -> 1 Timothée; Hebrews -> Hébreux; Galatians -> Galates; 1 Cor. (or 1 Corinthians) -> 1 Corinthiens (1 Cor.); Ephesians -> Éphésiens; Titus -> Tite. Apply these consistent French book names in every parenthetical reference and blockquote heading (do not change the numeric references). For example change "(Genesis 2:19–22)" to "(Genèse 2:19–22)", and "(Luke 2:39–42)" to "(Luc 2:39–42)".
findings.translation_quote: «Et l'Éternel Dieu forma...» (Genesis 2:19–22). — et d'autres références tout au long du texte sont laissées avec les noms de livres en anglais (par ex. Luke, 1 Timothy, Hebrews, Galatians, 1 Cor., Ephesians, Titus, etc.).
